status_note: EXT2025 extension of the accepted ARMS01 ATP comparison to 2017-2025 (design amendments A1 and A3), scored once with the accepted ARMS01 scorer. 2025 was inspected before the model freeze (D134) and scored by REFIT2025 (D137 ATP, D138 WTA): it is exposed retrospective data, not a holdout. The accepted result (buildoak_2017_2024.json, archive decisions D131 and D132) remains the registered claim; its headline numbers are carried unchanged under accepted_result. Accepted as archive decision D139, independently reconstructed (REC2, verdict ACCEPT).

registration.amendments: A1 (BuildOak 2025 fits; accepted 2024 reproductions byte-identical before the 2025 output is used), A3 (scoring: accepted ARMS01 scorer, frozen model as the only Alcaraz arm, blend years extended by 2025, no power restatement)
registration.readings: EXT2025 fixes readings, not gates: every extended number is reported whatever it shows; the scorer's verdict strings are kept under scorer_verdicts and read descriptively (A3)

endpoint.estimand: match-weighted paired log-loss difference, left minus right, on identical matches; negative favours the left
endpoint.note: Brier and winner accuracy are descriptive companions; log loss is the sole gated endpoint.

cohort.definition: all ATP primary targets 2017-2025: the accepted 2017-2024 ARMS01 membership in its order, then the 2025 REFIT2025 primary targets with a frozen-model forecast; three Roland Garros 2025 rows recorded as best of three carry no forecast by rule and are excluded; neutral orientation; retirements retained

arm1.label: full_tier_entry
arm1.role: the frozen model (D134): ARMS01 attempt 002 forecasts for 2017-2024, REFIT2025 attempt 001 for 2025; the only Alcaraz arm scored (A3)

arm0.label: full_tier
arm0.role: the previous version; its forecast files are bound for the record and it is not scored in EXT2025 (A3)

buildoak.label: BuildOak XGBoost adaptation
buildoak.adaptation: the accepted ARMS01 walk-forward replay for 2017-2024 plus one fit at the 2024-12-30 boundary for 2025 with the frozen adaptation, in the same Colima adapter; the 2025 output is used only because the accepted 2024 run reproduced byte for byte in that environment (A1)
buildoak.structural_break: ATP 2025 is the first ATP season in which the frozen adapter activates its recent-era model: 15,959 recent rows (from 2019-01-01) against its frozen threshold of 15,000, so every one of the 2,589 2025 targets gets 0.8 of the full model plus 0.2 of the recent model (A1); the 2017-2024 forecasts never used it, so the 2025 BuildOak forecasts come from a structurally different recipe

reproduction_2024.rule: the 2025 output is used only if the accepted 2024 run reproduces byte for byte in the same environment (A1)

contrast3_blend.form: blend logit = (1 - w) * logit(Alcaraz) + w * logit(BuildOak)
contrast3_blend.rule: per target year, minimise match-weighted log loss over the preceding 3 target years' saved forecasts; ties to the smaller weight; never fitted on the target year

readings.gates: none: EXT2025 fixes readings, not gates (A3); the scorer's verdict strings stay in the archive result file and are not a pass or a release
readings.blend: descriptive: the registered blend test is the accepted one and stays the claim; no blend is released and the model is frozen (D134)

blend_interval_seed_sensitivity.reading: the 2020-2025 blend - Alcaraz interval touches zero: its upper bound is below zero under the registered seed but not under most alternative seeds

uncertainty_method.method: stationary calendar-week bootstrap on one pooled inclusive Monday grid, match-weighted ratio within each draw, percentile interval
uncertainty_method.week_label: ISO week of the panel's tourney_anchor_date (calendar Monday)
uncertainty_method.equal_year_secondary: per-year inclusive Monday grids resampled independently, mean of yearly match-weighted means, percentile interval; a draw with an empty year is skipped and counted
uncertainty_method.conditioning: intervals condition on the saved forecasts and omit refit, selection and source-choice uncertainty

arm1_minus_pinnacle_normalised.label: normalised Pinnacle on the priced subset (descriptive)

accepted_result.note: the registered result, unchanged (buildoak_2017_2024.json); shown beside the extension

limitations: exposed retrospective comparison of complete systems with different legitimate histories; not an untouched test, prospective evidence or a market claim

2025 was inspected before the model freeze (D134) and scored by REFIT2025 (D137 ATP, D138 WTA): it is exposed retrospective data, not a holdout. The extended interval shares its first seasons with the registered one and is not an independent confirmation.

ATP 2025 is the first ATP season in which the frozen adapter activates its recent-era model: 15,959 recent rows (from 2019-01-01) against its frozen threshold of 15,000, so every one of the 2,589 2025 targets gets 0.8 of the full model plus 0.2 of the recent model (A1); the 2017-2024 forecasts never used it, so the 2025 BuildOak forecasts come from a structurally different recipe
the BuildOak recipe was selected by its author on ROC AUC with sight of 2026 data
intervals condition on saved forecasts; no family-wise adjustment
no claim beyond the named systems, this cohort and paired log loss
interpretation: Descriptive extension: on 21,561 ATP matches from 2017 to 2025, Alcaraz (full_tier_entry) minus BuildOak is −0.0067 [−0.0095, −0.0041] (8-week block bootstrap), negative in 8 of 9 seasons; 2025 alone −0.0047. The registered claim remains the accepted result.
